topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: I can't believe this. Someone took my art, the very essence of my being, and carved it into their skin. My paintings are meant to be seen, felt, in the quiet sanctity of galleries or on the pages of carefully curated catalogs. Now, my work is walking around, skewed and immortalized in flesh. I tried to reach out, to ask why, to understand, but what can you say to someone who sees your creation as theirs to mark? It's out there now, a permanent mutation of my intent. I'm supposed to be grateful, they say, for the recognition. Even the thanks feel wrong, like sandpaper against an open wound.
